pre_registered.headline: Share of activities whose assignment differs between the naive baseline and the solver optimum.
pre_registered.second: The coordination cost per handoff at which the optimum flips away from concentration, and whether it sits inside the defensible range.

fair_comparison.note: The best assignment that still concentrates in the baseline's city and obeys every constraint. Whatever separates it from the optimum is coordination cost and not a control failure.

rejected_crossings_floor.why_rejected: The last improvement before this price is worth 1.1% of crossings. A definition that calls that the flip is measuring the end of the sweep, not a tipping point.

gold_set.note: Hand-labelled by the author across all 42 activities. Agreement with one careful reading, not with an external ground truth.

disagreements.reason: Many users manually decide delivery status changes, no batch automation
Manual quantity revisions by many users require case-by-case decisions
Manual decision to reject/unreject, low volume, no automation
Manual users decide correct storage location, varies by case
Many distinct users decide what and how much to requisition
Deciding to delete a PO item requires human evaluation, not automated
System error status transfer, single actor, rule-based processing step

activities.name: Record Goods Receipt
activities.why: Confirmation against a delivery note; the highest-volume clerical step.

activities.name: Create Purchase Order Item
activities.why: Conversion of an approved requisition; 185 users and 7.6% already batch.

activities.name: Record Invoice Receipt
activities.why: Invoice entry and three-way match; the canonical AP clerk task.

activities.name: Vendor creates invoice
activities.why: The supplier's own act. Recorded in the log, not performed by the buyer.

activities.name: Clear Invoice
activities.why: Payment release against a matched invoice; 24 users, zero batch events.

activities.name: Record Service Entry Sheet
activities.why: Service equivalent of a goods receipt. The log carries no resource for it, so its performer is inferred rather than observed — stated because it is the second-largest volume in the model.

activities.name: Remove Payment Block
activities.why: Requires finding why the block fired and deciding to release it; the largest rework loop in the log at 57,136 events.

activities.name: Create Purchase Requisition Item
activities.why: Requester-facing intake, keyed against a catalogue; clerical volume work.

activities.name: Receive Order Confirmation
activities.why: Matching the supplier's acknowledgement to the order.

activities.name: Change Quantity
activities.why: Amendment agreed with the supplier before delivery.

activities.name: Change Price
activities.why: A commercial change; touches what is owed, so it carries authority.

activities.name: Delete Purchase Order Item
activities.why: Cancellation on the requester's instruction; clerical once decided.

activities.name: Change Approval for Purchase Order
activities.why: Re-approval after a change; the control that makes changes safe.

activities.name: Cancel Invoice Receipt
activities.why: Reversal of a posted invoice; needs a reason and usually a supplier call.

activities.name: Vendor creates debit memo
activities.why: As above — supplier-side, cannot be assigned to a delivery model.

activities.name: Change Delivery Indicator
activities.why: Flag maintenance on the line; no commercial content.

activities.name: Cancel Goods Receipt
activities.why: Reversal against a physical receipt, checked with the receiving site.

activities.name: SRM: In Transfer to Execution Syst.
activities.why: Interface hand-off; 93.3% batch.

activities.name: SRM: Document Completed
activities.why: Workflow status; 88.1% batch.

activities.name: SRM: Created
activities.why: Workflow status; 88.5% batch on a single id.

activities.name: SRM: Ordered
activities.why: Workflow status; 100% batch on a single id.

activities.name: SRM: Complete
activities.why: Workflow status; 88.1% batch.

activities.name: SRM: Awaiting Approval
activities.why: Status flag; the approval itself is Release Purchase Order.

activities.name: Release Purchase Order
activities.why: Commits the company to spend. Authority sits with the business.

activities.name: SRM: Change was Transmitted
activities.why: Interface confirmation; 100% batch on a single id.

activities.name: Reactivate Purchase Order Item
activities.why: Release of the hold above, once whatever caused it is resolved.

activities.name: Block Purchase Order Item
activities.why: A hold on a line pending resolution; a decision, not a keystroke.

activities.name: Cancel Subsequent Invoice
activities.why: Reversal of a supplementary charge; rare and individually investigated.

activities.name: Release Purchase Requisition
activities.why: Budget-holder release against a threshold; 42% already runs in batch.

activities.name: Change Storage Location
activities.why: Master-data correction against the receiving site.

activities.name: Update Order Confirmation
activities.why: Correcting a confirmation against what the supplier actually sent.

activities.name: SRM: Deleted
activities.why: Workflow status; 100% batch on a single id.

activities.name: Record Subsequent Invoice
activities.why: Posting a supplementary charge against an existing PO.

activities.name: Set Payment Block
activities.why: A deliberate hold placed on a supplier account or document.

activities.name: SRM: Transfer Failed (E.Sys.)
activities.why: An integration failure someone has to diagnose; 45 events, one user, no batch.

activities.name: Change Currency
activities.why: Changes the FX exposure on a commitment; a treasury-adjacent decision.

activities.name: Change Final Invoice Indicator
activities.why: Closes a line to further invoicing; a flag with a checked consequence.

activities.name: SRM: Transaction Completed
activities.why: Workflow terminal status; 8 events in the log.

activities.name: Change payment term
activities.why: Working-capital terms are negotiated, not maintained.

activities.name: SRM: Held
activities.why: Workflow status; 100% batch, 6 events.

activities.name: SRM: Incomplete
activities.why: Workflow status; 100% batch, 6 events.

activities.name: Change Rejection Indicator
activities.why: Flag maintenance; two events in the whole log.
